visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a black t-shirt and blue jeans walks towards a restaurant entrance shaded by a large blue and white beach-style umbrella. A tall menu stand on the left displays photographs of seafood bowls and pricing. The setting is an outdoor urban sidewalk in bright daylight. (2) The camera transitions to a series of extreme close-ups showing deep bowls filled with curly egg noodles, broth, and several whole, pink-tinted squids topped with chopped green onions. A silver spoon is shown pouring clear, shimmering broth back into the bowl. (3) The focus shifts to a seafood porridge featuring large orange shrimp, fish skin, and squid. Chopsticks lift a single pink squid to show its texture. A spoon then scoops a mixture of white rice, squid, and broth. (4) A bowl of milkfish belly with translucent glass noodles is presented. A pair of chopsticks lifts a large, thick slice of white fish belly from the bowl, followed by a large clump of glass noodles mixed with green seaweed. (5) The camera pans across a refrigerated display case filled with small black plates of various colorful side dishes. Close-up shots follow, showing red kimchi and small dried fish mixed with peanuts and red chilies. (6) The scene moves inside the restaurant, showing a brightly lit dining area with several wooden tables and customers eating. The video concludes with a wide shot of the storefront under the blue umbrella with text overlays showing the address.
